title: fix(types): a bind-only `list` is accepted; `ListSchema.items` is optional with an at-least-one-of `bind` / `items` refinement (objectui#11405)
body:
Fixes #11405

Clause-②: yes — the `list` arm of `@object-ui/types` only widens. A bind-only `list` goes from refused to accepted; a `list` with neither key was refused before (at `items`) and is refused now (at the node). Nothing went from accepted to refused.

Dispatched run for the `domain:spec` seat (objectui#10217), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01VhxTqosz7wn54ahqyxgERT`, claim comment 5942476028, triage ruling 5941529511. Draft, left for the seat; the at-tier contract-review record is owed on the landing head before enqueue.

## What changes

- **zod face** (`packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts`): `ListSchema.items` is `.optional()`, and the arm ends in `.superRefine(listHasAnEntrySource, …)` with a `when` that always answers true, so the rule is reported beside any other issue on the node. A node with neither `bind` nor `items` is refused once, at the node: `code: custom`, `params.code: LIST_ENTRIES_REQUIRED`, a message naming both keys. The rule is at least one, not exactly one, because `items` is the renderer's fallback beside `bind`. Presence is `!== undefined`, as in `requireRecordSource`. The strict face carries the check, because its clone keeps `def.checks`.
- **TS face** (`packages/types/src/data-display.ts`): `items?: ListItem[]`. The docblock names the read site and the mirror refinement, in the shape `ObjectKanbanSchema.objectName` uses (objectui#7780). `bind` stays declared once, on `BaseSchema`.
- **Pin**: `packages/types/src/__tests__/list-bind-only-11405.test.ts`.
- **Docs** (AGENTS.md #2): `content/docs/components/data-display/list.mdx` documents `bind` / optional `items` and the at-least-one rule.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/11405-list-bind-only.md`, `@object-ui/types` minor.
- **Ledger row**: `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` gains one ADJUDICATED row for the new pin. The pin reads the two guides, and the ledger audit (`scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts`) fails on an unregistered reader. This row is outside the claim's declared file surface; see Deviations.

⛔ Not edited: `skills/**` (the four fences become valid as they stand), `list.tsx`, and every other arm.

## Zone 2 measurements

| | hypothesis | reading |
|---|---|---|
| H1 | the faces, and the refusal | Confirmed on base `7728c67c8` (rebuilt dist). `{ type: list, bind: customerNames }` is refused with `invalid_type` at `items` by the arm, `safeValidateSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema`. A `list` with neither key was refused the same way, at `items`. |
| H2 | the refinement in the union | `superRefine` on the arm keeps it a valid `DataDisplaySchema` / `AnyComponentSchema` member: the module loads, `DataDisplaySchema._zod.propValues.type` still holds `list`, and a wrong literal is still `invalid_union` at `type`. The issue lands at the node: `[]` at the root, `children.0` when nested. Precedent: `requireRecordSource` already sits on discriminated arms. **TS union spelling, measured with a probe**: it refuses a literal with neither key, but the TS2322 names only `bind` as missing. The reader's type for `schema.items` is identical to the optional member's (`ListItem[]` or undefined). An interface can no longer extend it (TS2312), and a type alias drops declaration merging. So it was not taken: no reader gains, and three precedent arms (`object-kanban`, `object-map`, `object-tree`) keep the optional member plus a mirror refinement. |
| H3 | readers of `ListSchema['items']` | Type-checker census over one program from the repo-root tsconfig (5787 files): one read site, `list.tsx`'s `Array.isArray(schema.items) ? schema.items : []`, guarded. `@object-ui/components` type-check is green against the rebuilt types. Nothing to retype. |
| H4 | the registration | `list.tsx`'s `items` input carries no `required`. The console parity guard has no `list` row, and `check:component-surface-parity` compares key sets only. The registration is left alone. |
| H5 | the fences | Read off disk with `scanSkillFences` (the marker gate's own reader) and judged through `safeValidateSchema` and the strict face. Four marked fences author a bind-only `list`. The three taught as valid pass. The fence the guide marks as wrong is refused only at `children`, never at `items` and never on the new rule. |
| H6 | parity | Both faces move together, so no `zod-mirror-parity` row opens; that file is untouched. Ablation M3 below shows the TS face moving alone reddens the parity ratchet. |

## Verification (landing head `8b317ec61`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (three legs, including `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose `--listFilesOnly` includes the new pin): exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: `Test Files 321 passed (321)`, `Tests 8560 passed (8560)`.
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check`: exit 0.
- Consumer and ledger suites, 15 files: the components list and bind tests (`list-title-declared-11347`, `list-item-content-channel-9590`, `shadowed-renderer-behaviour`, `bind-base-prop-parser-tier-11008`, `skill-guide-data-table-binding`), `markdown-test-inputs`, `check-skill-examples`, and the changeset-script suites that name the ledger. Result: `Test Files 15 passed (15)`, `Tests 494 passed (494)`.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:component-surface-parity --type list` (report-only), `check:prompt-keys`, `check:pre-install-import-graph`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `markdown-test-inputs --audit`, and `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the six changed paths (NOT GOVERNED).
- **Narrowed, declared**: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` need the whole-workspace build (`check:doc-examples` exited 2, could-not-run). In their place, the `list.mdx` ts fence was compiled `--strict` against the rebuilt `@object-ui/types` dist (exit 0), with a failing control in the same harness (TS2322, exit 2). CI builds their closure.
- **Lint, narrowed and proven**: the population is read from eslint's own config. Four changed files are linted: `data-display.zod.ts`, `data-display.ts`, the pin, and `markdown-test-inputs.mjs`. The `.mdx` and the changeset are reported as "no matching configuration". The count of 4 comes from `--format json`. Result: 0 errors. `data-display.ts` has 30 `no-explicit-any` warnings, the same 30 as its base blob. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

## Ablation (fix committed first, each leg through `ablation-replace`, restored from HEAD and proven blob-equal)

- **M1**, zod `items` required again: 11 failed, 1 passed of 12. Only the counter-probe stays green, which is correct.
- **M2**, refinement removed: 5 failed, 7 passed. The five are the "neither" rows and the nested and beside-another-fault rows; bind-only stays green. ⚠️ The first M2 attempt was a no-op: the replacement count did not rise, so the tool refused it before the command ran. It was re-run with a delete-mode anchor.
- **M3**, TS `items` required again: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2. TS2741 at the pin's bind-only literal, plus the `zod-mirror-parity` ratchet (TS2322 on `data-display.zod.ts#ListSchema` and `items`).
- **Control**, unmutated HEAD: 12 of 12 passed, tsc exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The TypeScript face cannot spell "at least one": a literal with neither key still compiles. The validator enforces the rule, as for `object-kanban`.
- `content/docs/guide/expressions.md` ("Scoped Data", "Index in Loops") teaches a `list` with `items` as a string, an `itemTemplate` and per-item `item` / `index` expressions. The published `skills/objectui` expressions guide refutes that shape. `safeValidateSchema` refuses it at `items`, and the strict face adds `unrecognized_keys` for `itemTemplate`. `check-doc-expression-carriage` already lists both sites, and its header points to that family's open cards. Noted, not filed. Untouched here.
- `tree-view` is the other `useDataScope` reader in `@object-ui/components`. Measured: it already accepts a bind-only node, so the same defect is not present there.

## Deviations

- `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`: one ledger row, outside the claim's file surface. It is required because the claimed pin reads the guides off disk, and `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` fails on an unregistered reader. The script's own suite and its importers ran green (above).
